summary: So-Young International Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. The release details operational and financial metrics such as revenues (RMB432.8 million) and net loss (RMB49.2 million), along with center count and user activity. There are no special-situation transactions like mergers, tender offers, restructurings, or management changes. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer and does not announce or trigger any corporate event that would classify it as a special situation.
